items.headline: College football Week 2 live: Best moments, top plays and more
items.description: Week 2 is bookended by two great helmet games: Ohio State-Texas and Oklahoma-Michigan. Here's the best of the day.

items.headline: Sooners LB Kip Lewis exits with apparent right knee injury
items.description: Oklahoma standout linebacker Kip Lewis will not return against Michigan after sustaining an apparent right knee injury in the first quarter.

items.headline: SEC Nation crew debates whether Michigan will challenge No. 11 Oklahoma
items.description: Roman Harper and Chase Daniel expect the Sooners to breeze by Michigan in Ann Arbor, but Tim Tebow thinks Week 1 has his fellow analysts overlooking the Wolverines.

items.headline: Doering, Watson analyze how OU's defense can disrupt Michigan
items.description: The SEC Now crew explains how the Sooners' stout defense can create problems for Michigan as Benjamin Watson warns, "It could be an early Halloween in the Big House."

items.headline: Top 25 betting lines: Longhorns, Sooners favored in the week's biggest matchups
items.description: This week's odds and FPI predictions for Texas-Ohio State, Michigan-Oklahoma and every top 25 matchup.

items.headline: Bill Connelly's Week 2 preview: Big Ten-SEC challenge, early conference tests
items.description: Bluebloods have a chance at the early-season's biggest win. Big 12 and SEC have early conference challenges, and the G6 has an elimination weekend.
